# Style 10 · Kinetic Sport

> Built to move.

**Keywords:** Fast · Powerful · Gritty · Competitive · Urban  
**Mood:** Energetic · Bold  
**Sectors:** Sports & fitness · Retail & FMCG · Media, arts & culture  
**Strongest applications:** Advertising · Social media · Events · Websites · Brand identity

> **Fictional sample brand.** Stride District, running club and athletic wear, and every person, figure and address in its examples are invented to demonstrate this style. This is not client work. Domains use the reserved `.example` TLD.

## Concept

Kinetic Sport turns speed into graphics: condensed italic type, diagonal cuts, motion blur and high-contrast colour. Every layout should feel like it is moving forward, so it suits brands that sell performance, energy and community.

## Target industries

- Sportswear and sneakers
- Gyms, fitness studios and clubs
- Energy and sports drinks
- Marathons and sports events
- Esports teams
- Automotive and motorsport

## Color palette

| Name | Hex | Role | Share |
| --- | --- | --- | ---: |
| Asphalt | `#121212` | Primary background | 45% |
| Chalk | `#F7F7F5` | Text, light sections | 25% |
| Blaze | `#FF3D00` | Primary accent, speed marks | 15% |
| Concrete | `#B8B8B4` | Secondary text, textures | 8% |
| Cobalt | `#1F4BFF` | Secondary accent, team colour | 7% |

**Rule:** Use high contrast always. Blaze goes on Asphalt or Chalk, never on Cobalt. Use one accent per layout and switch between Blaze and Cobalt across a campaign.

## Typography

| Role | Family | Weights | Use |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Display | **Anton** | 400 (heavy condensed) | Headlines, numbers, slogans, uppercase only |
| Body | **Barlow** | 400, 600, 700 · italic | Body, UI, stats |
| Utility | **Barlow Condensed** | 600 italic | Labels, race data, timers |
| Arabic | **Lalezar (display) · Cairo (body)** | | Lalezar's heavy weight matches Anton's impact. Slant with layout, never with a fake oblique. |

**Type scale** (desktop, px size / line height)

| Level | Size | Weight | Detail |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Display | 120 / 100 | 400 | Uppercase, skewed -8°, tight leading |
| H1 | 56 / 54 | 400 | Uppercase |
| H2 | 26 / 30 | 700 | Barlow italic uppercase |
| Body | 16 / 24 | 400 | Barlow |
| Stat | 14 / 16 | 600 | Barlow Condensed italic, +6% tracking |

- Set headlines in uppercase only and keep them short, ideally under 5 words.
- Skew headline blocks about -8° to imply motion.
- Use stats (times, distances, reps) as graphic elements.

## Layout rules

- **Grid:** 12 columns · 16px gutter · diagonal 8° section cuts
- **Spacing:** 8px base. Dense and compact. Energy over air.
- **Corners:** 0. Use angled cut corners instead.

- Cut sections on an 8° diagonal.
- Let type run large and crop off the edge.
- Use speed stripes in Blaze behind key elements.
- Angle corners on buttons and cards.
- Stack headline, stat and CTA tightly.

## Photography direction

Athletes in motion, gritty urban settings, hard light and grain.

- Peak action: mid-stride, mid-jump, sweat.
- Low angles to make athletes heroic.
- Hard sunlight or night city light with flares.
- Motion blur and panning shots.
- High contrast black-and-white with an accent colour overlay.

**Sample shot list**

1. Runner mid-stride, low angle, panning blur (grade: `#FF7A4D` → `#FF3D00` → `#121212`)
2. Night track, floodlights, sweat close-up (grade: `#5A5A58` → `#2A2A2A` → `#0A0A0A`)
3. Crew run on concrete overpass, b/w + cobalt (grade: `#6F8BFF` → `#1F4BFF` → `#121212`)

**Avoid**

- Static posed gym selfies
- Soft pastel lifestyle shots
- Centred, symmetrical compositions

## Graphic elements

- Diagonal speed stripes
- Angled cut corners (clip-path)
- Oversized stat numbers (race times, km)
- Halftone and grain textures
- Tape and sticker-style labels

## UI examples

- Buttons: Blaze fill, cut corner, uppercase Barlow bold.
- Stat cards: big Anton number, condensed label.
- Progress bars and timers as core UI.
- Fast 150ms transitions, slide in from the left.

- Primary button: `Join the club` · Secondary button: `Shop the kit`
- Input: Target pace: `4:45 / km`
- Tags: `10K` `Sunday 6AM` `All levels`
- Card: **Night Run 10K**, Corniche · 42 runners, 48:12

## Social media examples

- Results and stats posts: one huge number.
- Event countdowns with skewed type.
- Reels with hard cuts on the beat.

| Format | Eyebrow | Headline | CTA |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Feed post 1080 × 1080 | Sunday crew run | No finish line. |  |
| Story 1080 × 1920 | Race day | 42.2 KM | Register |
| Feed ad 1080 × 1350 | New: Velocity Kit | Faster than yesterday. | Shop now |

## Website example

- Hero with a huge skewed headline cropped off the edge.
- Event calendar as angled cards with stats.
- Diagonal section transitions throughout.

- **Navigation:** Runs · Kit · Events · Join
- **Hero eyebrow:** Run club · Est. 2019
- **Hero headline:** Run the city.
- **Hero copy:** Free crew runs every week, from first 5K to marathon pace, plus kit built for the heat.
- **Actions:** Join the club / Shop the kit
- **Proof row:** 3,200 (Members running weekly) · 18 (Routes across the city) · 6AM (Every Sunday, all paces)

## Advertising campaign

**Campaign:** Run the City

Real routes and distances become headlines, placed on or near the routes themselves.

| Format | Eyebrow | Headline | CTA |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Billboard 48-sheet (6096 × 3048 mm) | Stride District · Route 07 | 6AM. 10K. Your city. | Join free · stridedistrict.example |
| Display MPU 300 × 250 and leaderboard 728 × 90 | | Faster than yesterday. | Shop |

- Place ads on running routes: bridges, the corniche, metro exits.
- Motion banners cut on the beat with 150ms transitions.
- Use real stats only. Never invent performance claims.

## Presentations

- **Cover slide:** Sponsor deck 2027 · **Run the city.** · Stride District partnerships · sample deck
- **Content slide:** Who runs with us. Key figure **3,200** (members running weekly); points: 18 routes across the city; Sunday crew runs at 6AM; Night race series, 4 events. Figures are sample data.

- Diagonal cuts between slides.
- One huge stat per slide.
- Full-bleed action photography.

## Brand applications

Business card, letterhead and email signature for **Omar Khalil**, Head Coach (`omar@stridedistrict.example`, fictional).

| Application | Specification |
| --- | --- |
| Race bibs | Blaze number block, skewed Anton numerals |
| Kit | Asphalt tee with a Blaze diagonal stripe across the chest |
| Event arch | angled cut corners and speed stripes |
| Water bottles | Chalk with Cobalt stripe and route map |

- The skewed wordmark is the only logo. Never set it upright.
- Blaze and Cobalt never touch.
- Event graphics must stay legible at running speed: 5 words max.

## Do / Don't

| Do | Don't |
| --- | --- |
| Imply motion in everything | Rounded friendly shapes |
| Use real stats | Lowercase headlines |
| Crop boldly | Calm, centred layouts |

## Design tokens

Text in the accent colour uses `--avdl-accent-text`, which passes WCAG AA (4.5:1) on both `bg` and `surface`.

```css
[data-style="kinetic-sport"] {
  --avdl-bg: #121212;
  --avdl-surface: #1E1E1E;
  --avdl-ink: #F7F7F5;
  --avdl-muted: #B8B8B4;
  --avdl-accent: #FF3D00;
  --avdl-accent-text: #FF3D00;
  --avdl-accent-2: #1F4BFF;
  --avdl-on-accent: #121212;
  --avdl-line: #3A3A3A;
  --avdl-font-display: 'Anton', Impact, 'Arial Narrow', sans-serif;
  --avdl-font-body: 'Barlow', 'Arial Narrow', Arial, sans-serif;
  --avdl-display-weight: 400;
  --avdl-display-case: uppercase;
  --avdl-display-tracking: 0.005em;
  --avdl-radius: 0px;
  --avdl-button-radius: 0px;
  --avdl-border-width: 1px;
  --avdl-shadow: none;
  --avdl-color-asphalt: #121212;
  --avdl-color-chalk: #F7F7F5;
  --avdl-color-blaze: #FF3D00;
  --avdl-color-concrete: #B8B8B4;
  --avdl-color-cobalt: #1F4BFF;
}
```
